program.section_heading: Diesel Engine Systems Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion of this program, the student will be able to communicate basic diesel engine operational principles.
Upon the successful completion of this program, the student will be able to examine and explain the common emissions system components found on modern diesel engines.
Upon the successful completion of this program, the student will be able to interpret technical service manuals and literature.
Upon the successful completion of this program, the student will be able to diagnose failures in a modern computer-controlled diesel engine using an electronic service tool.

notes: The award is counted in hours: the block is labeled 'Core Courses-72 hours (Credits listed are in hours)' and the total is printed as '72 - 0'. I read that as 72 hours, and each course's '18 - 0' as 18 hours.
The catalog prints the codes without a space (e.g. 'MCAGB50NC'). These match the closed-list codes 'MCAG B50NC' through 'MCAG B53NC', so catalog_addition is false for all four.
The career entry 'off-highway diesel engine repair' comes from the description's phrase 'the area of off-highway diesel engine repair'. A reviewer should confirm it counts as a career field.
The catalog URL slug references summer-2023 but sits under the 2026-2027 catalog.
